reviews.review_title: Cozy and Addictive VR Puzzle Gem! 💎
reviews.review_description:
Refract: Puzzles Made of Light is a wonderfully enjoyable puzzle game built around the fascinating properties of light. Your mission is simple in theory: guide a beam of light to its destination using reflection, refraction, prisms, and light dividers. In practice, things get increasingly interesting!

With 49 handcrafted puzzles spread across 8 different sets, there's plenty to explore. You can play using hand tracking or traditional controllers, which is a nice touch. Experiment with different configurations, redirect the light, split beams, and find the right combination to help the light reach its goal.

What I particularly enjoy is the relaxed approach. You can reset your experiments as many times as you like, without pressure or punishment. It's a soothing experience with progressively more challenging puzzles that gradually introduce greater complexity.

It actually reminds me of the shrines in Zelda, with that same satisfying feeling of figuring out a puzzle through observation, experimentation, and a little bit of lateral thinking.

Don't let the cozy presentation fool you, though. There's genuine depth here! The puzzles become increasingly engaging, and before you know it, you find yourself wanting to solve just one more.

Solid execution, clever mechanics, and a very pleasant atmosphere make Refract a great addition to the VR puzzle genre.

A relaxing yet surprisingly addictive little gem. Highly recommended for anyone who enjoys brain teasers and thoughtful puzzle-solving in VR!
